full_prompt_en: A square chibi anime illustration shows a small blond girl standing on a large textured golden star against a swirling deep blue background. The blue field circles around the center in visible curved brush marks, with darker navy near the corners and scattered tiny stars along the left and right sides. The central five-pointed star is broad and irregular. Its surface is built from overlapping pale cream, honey, and ocher pieces, more like tiny painted paper fragments than a smooth flat shape. The lower-left point is warmer orange, while the right point fades to lighter yellow and cream. At the star's center, the girl stands in a simple upright pose, her small shoes planted close together. She has an oversized round face, short bright yellow hair, one upward flick of hair above the head, and a large dark blue bow at the back. Big oval blue eyes look up and left, and faint pink cheeks soften her simple expression. She wears a white short-sleeved blouse beneath a dark blue pinafore dress, with the skirt rounded around her small body and dark shoes below. A muted cool shadow falls onto the star beneath and slightly behind her, giving the tiny character a clear foothold. Light is gentle and even, though the star seems brighter than the surrounding blue and gives the center a warm glow. The outline is clean around the girl, while the star and background remain rough, stippled, and visibly hand-painted. No readable text appears. The overall composition is playful and dreamlike, setting a tiny precise character within an expansive field of swirling blue and patchwork gold.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形Q版动漫插画呈现一位金发小女孩，站在一颗巨大而有肌理的金色星星上，周围是旋绕的深蓝背景。蓝色色域以可见的弧形笔触围住中央，四角更接近海军蓝，左右散有细小星点。中央五角星宽大且边缘不规则，表面由重叠的浅乳色、蜂蜜色和赭黄色碎片组成，更像细小的彩绘纸片，而非平滑纯色形状。左下角星尖偏暖橙色，右侧星尖则淡入浅黄与乳白。女孩站在星星中央，姿势简单直立，两只小鞋靠近落在表面。她有夸张圆脸、短而明亮的黄发、头顶向上翘起的一缕头发，以及脑后宽大的深蓝蝴蝶结。椭圆形蓝色大眼睛望向左上，淡粉脸颊让简洁表情更柔软。她穿白色短袖上衣和深蓝背带裙，裙摆围成圆润的小身体，下方是深色鞋子。一道低饱和冷影落在她脚下并略向后延伸，使小人物稳稳站在星上。光线温和且均匀，但星星比周围蓝色更亮，让中央透出暖光。女孩的轮廓干净，星星和背景则粗涩、点状且明显手绘。没有可读文字。整体构图俏皮而梦幻，把一位细致的小角色放入辽阔的旋涡蓝色与拼片金色之中。
style_prompt_en: The chibi-style illustration sets crisp, simplified focal contours against an expansive, visibly hand-worked color field. Deep cobalt and navy swirl in broad curved brush marks, while cream, ocher, and honey-colored fragments collect into luminous central shapes. The surface alternates between small patchwork dabs and larger directional strokes, giving a tactile collage-like impression without losing painted unity. Rounded forms and large simple color areas create an immediately readable focal point; tiny accents supply sparkle around it. Light is soft and largely ambient, with value contrast between a glowing warm center and cool dark perimeter doing more work than cast shadows. Irregular edges keep the geometry playful and handmade. The arrangement is centered but not sterile, because grain, brush arcs, and scattered small shapes move around the core. The overall effect is innocent, buoyant, and dreamy, with vivid color and material texture reinforcing one another.
style_prompt_zh: 这种Q版插画把清晰简化的焦点轮廓放在辽阔、明显带手工痕迹的色域前。深钴蓝与海军蓝形成宽阔弧形笔触的旋涡，乳白、赭黄和蜂蜜色碎片则聚为发光的中央形状。画面表面在小片拼贴般点笔与较大的方向性笔触之间交替，形成可触的拼片印象，却没有失去统一的绘画感。圆润形体与大块简洁色面让焦点立即可读，细小重音在周围提供闪烁。光线柔和且主要来自环境，发光般暖中心与冷暗周缘的明度反差比投影承担更多作用。不规则边缘让几何形状俏皮而有手工气息。安排虽居中，却不呆板，因为颗粒、弧形笔势和散落小形体围绕核心运动。整体效果天真、轻快而梦幻，鲜艳色彩与材料肌理彼此加强。
theme_en: A small anime girl standing on a textured golden star
theme_zh: 一位小小的动漫女孩站在有肌理的金色星星上
name: Lucky Star
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
